So, today is your last day. What time is your flight?
At eleven forty, at night. It's a long flight.
And when do you arrive in Brazil?
At nine in the morning. And school starts again on Monday.
On Monday? That's fast. What time do you go to the airport?
In the afternoon, at four. I don't want to be late.
Good. Are you coming back next year?
I want to. Maybe in July. Send me a message and we talk.
I wake up at half past five, in the morning.
At night I watch a series.
What time does the flight leave?
I don't want to be late.

Good afternoon, passengers. This is an announcement for flight two four one to Sao Paulo. The flight leaves at eleven forty tonight, from gate fifteen. Boarding starts at ten fifty, so please be at the gate at half past ten. The flight arrives in Sao Paulo at nine in the morning, local time. Passengers with small children can board early. Please have your passport and your ticket ready. Thank you.

Hi Bruno, it's Tyler. So, my week. On Monday and Wednesday I have school until three, and then I go to practice. On Tuesday I work in my father's shop in the afternoon. I don't like waking up early on Thursday, because I have a test at seven thirty. On Friday night I play games with my friends until late. And in December we go to my grandmother's house for two weeks. Every year, the same thing. See you tomorrow.

Bruno wakes up early on the last day of the camp. He says goodbye to his friends in the morning. He takes the bus to the airport in the afternoon. He waits at the gate at ten thirty at night. He arrives in Brazil in the morning.
